boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Minnesota-Twin Cities
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with publicly listed late hours, centered on Dinkytown and extending to Minneapolis options for a later meal or pickup.

cards.title: Frank & Andrea Dinkytown
cards.subtitle: 1235 4th St SE, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Check the day before heading over: the Dinkytown location lists 2 a.m. closes Monday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. closes Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Dinkytown pizza and cheesesteak counter with especially late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank & Andrea’s official site lists its Dinkytown location at 1235 4th St SE and closing times as late as 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Frank & Andrea — Dinkytown location and hours
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours: Mon–Wed 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; Thu–Sat 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Dinkytown
cards.subtitle: 302 15th Ave SE, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Use the location’s day-by-day schedule before a late pickup; its Thursday through Saturday dining hours are listed through 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Dinkytown chicken-finger restaurant with late weekend hours on its official locator.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official Dinkytown page lists dine-in hours until 3 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed dine-in hours: 10 a.m.–midnight Sun–Wed; 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Thu–Sat.

cards.title: Mesa Pizza Dinkytown
cards.subtitle: 1323 4th St SE, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Plan for a late slice or pickup on Thursday through Saturday, and allow for the posted notice that the kitchen may stop before the store closes.
cards.short_summary: A Dinkytown pizza shop whose official schedule reaches 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Mesa Pizza’s official Dinkytown page lists hours until 1 a.m. Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours: Sun–Wed 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Thu 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–2 a.m. The site says the kitchen closes 15–30 minutes earlier.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill Dinkytown
cards.subtitle: 1421 4th St SE, Minneapolis
cards.notes: For an earlier late-night option on the Dinkytown corridor, confirm the restaurant’s current 11 p.m. closing time before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A Dinkytown burrito-and-bowl stop officially listed until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official Dinkytown location page lists restaurant hours of 10:45 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed restaurant hours: 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m., Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Pizza Lucé Seward
cards.subtitle: 2200 E Franklin Ave, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Use the Seward location’s ordering channel when later service matters: its page separately lists delivery and pickup through 1 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Minneapolis Pizza Lucé location with delivery and pickup listed until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Lucé’s official Seward page lists delivery and pickup until 1 a.m. every day, with dine-in until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours: delivery and pickup 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; dine-in 11 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Pizza Lucé Uptown
cards.subtitle: 3200 Lyndale Ave S, Minneapolis
cards.notes: For a later pickup or delivery, use the Uptown location’s schedule rather than assuming its dining-room hours match; the two are listed separately.
cards.short_summary: An Uptown Pizza Lucé location with pickup and delivery extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Lucé’s official Uptown page lists delivery and pickup until 2 a.m. most nights and 2:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed delivery/pickup: until 2 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2:30 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in is listed until midnight.

cards.title: Leaning Tower of Pizza
cards.subtitle: 2324 Lyndale Ave S, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Check the current location page before traveling to Uptown; it lists service until 2 a.m. every day and gives the full street address.
cards.short_summary: An Uptown pizza restaurant that publicly lists a 2 a.m. close every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Leaning Tower of Pizza’s official site lists its Minneapolis location at 2324 Lyndale Ave S and hours until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Leaning Tower of Pizza — hours and location
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours: 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Friday; noon–2 a.m. Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: The Nicollet Diner
cards.subtitle: 1333 Nicollet Mall, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Keep this downtown diner in mind for a meal outside ordinary closing windows; its own site says it operates 24 hours a day, every day.
cards.short_summary: A downtown diner whose official site advertises 24-hour daily service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nicollet Diner’s official website states that it is open 24 hours a day, every day, at 1333 Nicollet Mall.
cards.access_notes: Official site states: “24 Hours a Day, Every Day.” Confirm any service details directly with the diner before going.

cards.title: Hard Times Cafe
cards.subtitle: 1821 Riverside Ave, Minneapolis
cards.notes: For a Cedar-Riverside stop, use the current listing as a guide and arrive before midnight; the visitor bureau lists daily hours from 8 a.m. to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Cedar-Riverside vegetarian café publicly listed as open until midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Meet Minneapolis lists Hard Times Cafe in Cedar-Riverside as open from 8 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: Meet Minneapolis — A Night Owl’s Guide to Minneapolis
cards.access_notes: Meet Minneapolis lists Hard Times Cafe hours as 8 a.m.–midnight. Confirm directly before traveling, as hours can change.

cards.title: Nightingale
cards.subtitle: 2551 Lyndale Ave S, Minneapolis
cards.notes: If you are heading toward Lyndale, use the restaurant’s stated kitchen cutoff rather than its room closing time: food is listed through midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: A Lyndale restaurant whose official page lists a midnight kitchen close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Nightingale’s official site lists daily hours from 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. and states that its kitchen is open until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours: 5 p.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Saturday; the site specifies that the kitchen is open until midnight.
